theater: 羅馬城與第勒尼安海海道

battle.name: 羅馬之劫 (455年)
battle.theater: 羅馬城與第勒尼安海海道
battle.brief: 455年6月15日，汪達爾王基斯納里克的艦隊自北非橫渡第勒尼安海，在奧斯蒂亞外海登陸，攻入羅馬城，掠奪兩日，帶走西部帝國的府庫與兵器。這不是攻城戰的奇蹟，而是海權與補給的較量：野戰主力遠在北高盧，城內只剩守備與城牆。卡面的羅馬重步兵象徵一段已退場的傳統，決定勝負的是船隊與糧道。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 455年的羅馬之劫，交戰的兩邊是西羅馬帝國與汪達爾王國，但開戰時羅馬城裡連皇帝都沒有。汪達爾方面：國王基斯納里克自428年起統治北非，以迦太基為都，把羅馬行省的稅收與羅馬裔居民編入自己的王國，兵力核心是一支能集結數百艘船的艦隊，以及以步兵為主、輔以騎兵的汪達爾戰軍；王國同時握有西班牙、薩爾馬提亞與巴利阿里群島的進貢與船員。羅馬方面：西羅馬帝國這時只剩義大利、高盧南部、非洲行省的部分稅源與西班牙殘餘，國庫靠這些殘餘運作；455年初的皇帝佩特羅尼烏斯·馬西姆出身禁軍總監，先暗殺瓦倫提尼安三世再即位，隨即被城內反對者推翻並殺死，6月15日汪達爾入城時，西部帝國正處在無皇帝的空窗期，能守城的只有禁軍殘部、市區民兵與城防部隊，而野戰主力遠在北高盧與西哥特人對峙。第三方是東羅馬：君士坦丁堡在皇帝利奧一世與軍務總督阿斯帕爾手中，兵力和艦隊都足夠，455年卻沒有派出一支解援艦隊；直到468年，巴西利斯科斯才率龐大的遠征軍西進。
countriesEn: The sack of Rome in 455 was fought between the Western Roman Empire and the Vandal kingdom, but when the fighting started there was not even an emperor in the city. On the Vandal side: King Genseric had ruled North Africa since 428 with Carthage as his capital, folding the taxes and the Roman inhabitants of the Roman provinces into his kingdom; the core of his strength was a fleet able to assemble several hundred ships and a war-band of infantry with cavalry in support; the kingdom also drew tribute and seamen from Spain, Sardinia and the Balearic islands. On the Roman side: the Western Roman Empire by then held only Italy, the south of Gaul, part of the revenue of the African provinces and the remnants of Spain, and the treasury ran on what was left of those. The emperor of early 455, Petronius Maximus, had come from the praetorian guard; he had Valentinian III killed and then taken the throne, and was himself overthrown and killed by the opponents inside the city, so that when the Vandals entered on 15 June the Western Empire was in an interregnum with no emperor at all, and the only force that could defend the city was a fragment of the praetorian guard, the urban militia and the garrison; the field army was far away in the north of Gaul, facing the Visigoths. The third party was the Eastern Empire: Constantinople under the emperor Leo I and the magister militum Aspar had both troops and ships in abundance, yet sent no relief fleet in 455; only in 468 did Basiliscus lead a large expedition westward.
people: 這場劫掠牽涉六個關鍵人物。瓦倫提尼安三世是西羅馬最後幾位握有實權的皇帝之一，455年5月在拉文納被禁軍總監佩特羅尼烏斯·馬西姆策反的士兵割喉。馬西姆隨即稱帝，卻在同年5月被羅馬城中的反對者殺死，屍首投入台伯河。9月，高盧貴族阿維圖斯在阿爾勒與里昂一帶被元老院與軍方立為皇帝，他一面對付侵占南高盧的西哥特王狄奧多里克二世，一面收拾汪達爾留下的爛帳；456年他在科西嘉外海被基斯納里克的艦隊擊敗，退回拉文納後被米蘭方面的人殺死，帝位再落到馬里安手上。基斯納里克是全場真正的策劃者：他從不急著攻城，而是先把羅馬拖入戰爭，再挑羅馬守備最空的時刻登陸。他的父親根尼西克在430年渡海征服北非，基斯納里克接位後把王國的商船隊改造成地中海最大的武裝運輸船隊，並於439年取得北非行省，455年是他第一次直搗羅馬。良一（聖良一、教宗良一）率領教會代表在城外迎接基斯納里克並展開談判，換得已建成的城內建築免於焚毀、水渠不被破壞，樹立了主教擔任外交使者的先例。馬西姆的妻子歐多西亞被俘後送往迦太基，後來回到君士坦丁堡。留下記錄的人有普羅科匹烏斯、馬爾塞利努斯·科梅斯、希達提烏斯與西多尼烏斯·阿波利納利斯，四人對劫掠規模的說法彼此並不一致。
peopleEn: Six figures matter in this sack. Valentinian III was one of the last Western emperors to hold real power; in May 455 he was killed by soldiers turned by Petronius Maximus, the praetorian prefect, at Ravenna. Maximus was then acclaimed emperor, but within the same month he was killed by his opponents inside the city of Rome and his body thrown into the Tiber. In September Avitus, a Gallic aristocrat, was made emperor by the senate and the army around Arles and Lyon; he had to deal at once with Theodoric II, the Visigothic king who had seized the south of Gaul, and with the wreckage left by the Vandals; in 456 his fleet was beaten by Genseric off Corsica, and after he fell back to Ravenna he was killed by men sent from Milan, the throne passing on to Majorian. Genseric was the real architect of the whole affair: he was never in a hurry to storm anything, preferring first to drag Rome into a war and then to land at the moment when Rome's defence was emptiest. His father Genseric's predecessor Genseric the Elder, Genseric's father Gensisicus, crossed to North Africa in 430 and conquered it; Genseric converted the kingdom's merchant shipping into the largest armed transport fleet in the Mediterranean and took possession of the African provinces in 439; the sack of Rome in 455 was his first direct strike at the capital. Leo, Saint Leo, the pope, came out of the city with the clergy to meet Genseric and to negotiate, winning exemption for the city's buildings from fire and for its aqueducts from destruction, and thereby setting a precedent for bishops acting as envoys. Eudocia, Maximus's wife, was captured and taken to Carthage, and later returned to Constantinople. The writers who recorded the event are Procopius, Marcellinus Comes, Hydatius and Sidonius Apollinaris, and their accounts of the scale of the plunder do not agree with one another.
kits: 卡面是公元前100年前後的羅馬重步兵：分段鎧甲（lorica segmentata）、弧面大盾（scutum）、短劍與重標槍（pilum），靠的是公民兵源與國家供應的裝備體系。要說清它在455年的位置，先要說清它已經不在了：從3世紀起公民制崩解，軍團變成職業常備兵，兵源靠招募與補充；分段鎧甲大約在3世紀末退位給鱗甲與鎖子甲，4世紀中期之後基本絕跡於戰場，只在墓葬與雕像上留下形象。《軍政寶鑑》（Notitia Dignitatum）所列的西部單位裡，護盾兵與部分騎兵仍配大盾，可以說重步兵的血脈只以象徵與邊防的形式留下。真正投入455年事件的裝備是這樣的：汪達爾方面，步兵用長劍（spatha）、單刃短刀（seax）、蒙皮橢圓盾、長矛與複合弓，騎兵用矛與劍，軍中沒有重甲體系的傳統，縱掠靠的是船；艦隊是這一戰的主裝備，徵用商船作運輸船，另有小型登岸艇，士兵往往在海中游一段再登岸，整支船隊本身就是一次可以整建制投送的載體。攻城裝備是斧、梯、繩、火把與油料，以及搬走軍械、銅像與金銀器所用的車隊與吊裝工具。羅馬方面，靠的是奧勒良城牆、城樓上的弩炮（ballista）與標槍、防守城門的鎧甲兵（多是鎖子甲與鱗甲），以及從高盧與北非運糧的船；可惜北非行省的稅源已在439年後斷掉，海運的根也被切斷。卡面那句話——羅馬的戰力靠補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝——在455年得到殘酷的反證：分段鎧甲連影子都沒上過城牆，輸贏全看船與糧。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman heavy infantryman of about 100 BC: segmentata armour, the curved oval scutum, a short sword and the heavy javelin, the pilum, all of it resting on a citizen levy and on equipment supplied by the state. To place him in 455 one has to begin by admitting that he was already gone: from the third century the citizen army collapsed and the legion became a standing professional force, its numbers maintained by recruitment and replacement; segmentata fell out of favour for scale and mail around the end of the third century and after the middle of the fourth had largely vanished from the battlefield, surviving as an image in tombs and statues. In the Notitia Dignitatum the western units still list shield-bearers and some cavalry with the large shield, so the heavy infantry survives in 455 only in emblem and in the frontier. The equipment actually present in this affair was as follows. On the Vandal side, infantry with the spatha, the single-edged seax, hide-covered oval shields, long spears and the composite bow, cavalry with spear and sword; there was no tradition of heavy armour in the army, and the reach of the raid was bought with ships. The fleet was the main weapon of the campaign: merchant ships were taken up as transports, with smaller boats for landing, and the men often swam a stretch of sea before making the beach, so that the fleet itself was a vehicle capable of delivering an entire organisation in one movement. The assault equipment was axes, ladders, ropes, torches and oil, together with the wagons and lifting gear used to carry off arms, bronze statuary, plate and coin. On the Roman side there were the Aurelian wall, the ballistae on the towers with their javelins, the armoured men who held the gates, mostly in mail and scale, and the grain ships from Gaul and Africa; but the revenue of the African provinces had been lost after 439 and the roots of the sea supply had been cut. The line on the card, that Rome's strength lay in replenishing men and supply lines rather than in heavy equipment, is cruelly confirmed in 455: segmentata never so much as showed itself on the wall, and the whole result was decided by ships and grain.
tactics: 汪達爾的戰法不靠攻城器械，靠海。基斯納里克自迦太基北上，艦隊走西西里與薩丁尼亞之間的海道，抵達第勒尼安海後在奧斯蒂亞與波特斯外海轉入攻擊；羅馬在這段海岸的防衛幾乎為空，港內的糧船與海軍被牽制，艦隊直接進入可以登陸的海灣。登陸之後，他把城按區域分給各支隊，規定每支隊只准掠自己分到的部分，士兵多拿即死；這是普羅科匹烏斯記下的一段，也是這次劫掠沒有演成無差別焚城的原因之一。進城的路線是阿西納里亞門與城牆的缺口，守軍在城內，人數卻不足以封住各處；城內的實際抵抗靠禁軍殘部與市區民兵逐段退守，戰線沿阿庇亞大道、圖拉真廣場與凱撒廣場反覆拉鋸，最後連皇宮、巴西利卡與禁軍營地都被搬空。羅馬方面的反應不在城牆上，而在城牆之外：教宗良一率領教士與執事出城迎接基斯納里克，以交涉換取已建成的建築與水渠的安全，同時準備以贖金換取被擄者與被奪物資的返還，這是西方教會第一次以城市外交家的身分介入兵事。劫掠之後，汪達爾把西西里、薩丁尼亞、科西嘉與巴利阿里群島的港口一併掃過，並在456年由海路進入拉文納，奪走西部國庫的財貨與兵器，再把整支艦隊連同戰利品運回北非。
tacticsEn: The Vandal method relied not on siege engines but on the sea. Genseric sailed north from Carthage, the fleet taking the channel between Sicily and Sardinia, and once in the Tyrrhenian Sea turned to the attack off Ostia and Portus; Roman defence along that shore was almost nil, the grain ships in the harbour and the fleet were held up, and the squadron could move directly into a bay where it could land. After the landing he divided the city into quarters and gave them to the different units, allowing each unit to plunder only the quarter assigned to it and putting men to death for taking more; this is the passage Procopius preserves, and it is one reason the sack did not degenerate into a general burning. The way in was through the Porta Asinaria and a breach in the wall; the defenders were inside the city but too few to seal every approach, and the real resistance came from a fragment of the praetorian guard and the urban militia falling back street by street, the line shifting back and forth along the Via Appia, the Forum of Trajan and the Forum of Caesar, until the imperial palace, the basilica and the praetorium were emptied as well. The Roman response was not on the walls but outside them: Pope Leo went out from the city with the clergy and the deacons to meet Genseric, trading negotiation for the safety of the buildings already standing and of the aqueducts, and preparing to buy back those carried off and the goods taken, the first time the Western church entered military affairs as a city diplomat. After the plunder Genseric swept the harbours of Sicily, Sardinia, Corsica and the Balearics as well, and in 456 entered Ravenna by sea, took the treasure and the arms of the Western treasury, and carried the whole fleet and its loot back to Africa.
data: 能站得住的數字大致如下。時間：455年6月15日汪達爾入城（部分記載作16日），城內劫掠約兩日，艦隊於夏季結束前離開第勒尼安海；456年10月阿維圖斯在拉文納被殺，12月馬里安即位。艦隊：普羅科匹烏斯記汪達爾的船逾五百艘、載兵約三萬人，這是上限式的寫法，實際作戰人員應明顯低於此數。城防：455年羅馬城內可用之兵只有禁軍殘部與民兵，數目沒有可靠記載；野戰主力當時在萊茵與羅訥河一線。物資：羅馬的北非行省在439年後失去，西部帝國失去的是最重要的行省稅源；455年被搬走的包括軍械庫的兵器、府庫的金銀器與銅像。往後的數字：456年汪達爾奪拉文納，取走西部國庫；457年馬里安重建艦隊，460年這支艦隊在阿格里真托附近被毀，汪達爾遂掃掠意大利海岸直到熱那亞；468年巴西利斯科斯的遠征集結艦隊逾一千一百艘、兵員約十萬，卻在卡邦角附近全軍覆沒，此後汪達爾取得西西里。城市與距離：奧斯蒂亞距羅馬約二十公里，是全城的糧食咽喉；奧勒良城牆環城約十九公里。劫掠次數：410、455、472，476年為第四次也是最後一次。帝國壽命：476年西部帝國終結，距455年二十一年。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on run as follows. Time: the Vandals entered on 15 June 455 (some accounts say the 16th), the plunder inside the city lasted about two days, and the fleet left the Tyrrhenian Sea before the end of the summer; Avitus was killed at Ravenna in October 456 and Majorian came to the throne in December. The fleet: Procopius writes that Genseric had more than five hundred ships and about thirty thousand men aboard, which is an upper-bound sort of statement; the number actually fit for combat was clearly lower. The defences: the only troops available inside Rome in 455 were a fragment of the praetorian guard and the militia, and no reliable count exists; the field army was at the time on the Rhine and the Rhone. The materiel: Rome's African provinces were lost after 439, and what the Western Empire lost with them was its most valuable provincial revenue; what was carried away in 455 included the arms of the arsenals, the plate and coin of the treasury, and bronze statuary. Later figures: in 456 Genseric took Ravenna and with it the Western treasury; Majorian rebuilt a fleet in 457, and in 460 that fleet was destroyed off Agrigento, after which Genseric swept the Italian coast as far as Genoa; in 468 Basiliscus's expedition massed more than eleven hundred ships and about a hundred thousand men and was annihilated near Cape Bon, after which Genseric took Sicily. City and distances: Ostia lies about twenty kilometres from Rome and was the throat through which the city's grain came; the Aurelian wall ran about nineteen kilometres around the city. The number of sacks: 410, 455 and 472, with 476 the fourth and last. The life of the empire: the Western Empire ended in 476, twenty-one years after 455.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最直接的一層是馬西姆的對外政策：汪達爾與羅馬在439年訂有條約，基斯納里克多次索要土地、錢財與羅馬皇族的聯姻，馬西姆一面付款一面拖延，又企圖在基斯納里克即將返回北非時扣留他隨行的財貨與隨從；基斯納里克於是把艦隊掉頭北上，這是史料中對「為什麼突然打到義大利」最通行的解釋。第二層是財政：西羅馬的現金流依賴北非行省，439年後這條來源斷絕，455年的西部帝國連一支可以立即投入作戰的艦隊都湊不出，軍需靠東部的錢，稅基卻留在西部。第三層是戰略：義大利的防衛空虛，455年羅馬的野戰軍被拉去北高盧應付西哥特人狄奧多里克二世，羅馬城只剩下城牆與一支象徵性的守備。第四層是政治的崩解：一年之內瓦倫提尼安三世被自己人暗殺、馬西姆被城中反對者殺死、阿維圖斯到9月才加冕，帝國的信用與威信跌到谷底，讓羅馬人不再相信條約與贖買能換來安全，也讓基斯納里克相信羅馬沒有可以依靠的抵抗力量。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause. The most direct is the foreign policy of Maximus: the Vandals and Rome had a treaty in 439, Genseric repeatedly asked for land, for money and for a marriage into the Roman imperial family, and Maximus paid while stalling, then tried to seize the treasure and the retainers that Genseric was taking north when he left; Genseric accordingly turned his fleet about and sailed for Italy, which is the most widely accepted explanation in the sources for why the blow came so suddenly. The second layer is finance: the Western Empire's cash flow had depended on the African provinces, and after 439 that source was cut; in 455 the West could not even muster a fleet fit for immediate service, and the army was paid for out of money from the East while the tax base stayed in the West. The third layer is strategy: the defence of Italy was empty, the Roman field army had been pulled north to deal with the Visigothic king Theodoric II, and what remained of Rome was walls and a garrison that was symbolic rather than real. The fourth layer is the collapse of political authority: within a single year Valentinian III was murdered by his own men, Maximus was killed by the city's opponents, and Avitus was not crowned until September; the credit and prestige of the empire fell to the bottom, which taught the Romans that treaties and ransoms no longer bought safety and taught Genseric that Rome had no strength to rely on.
impact: 455年後，西羅馬的權威再沒有恢復。西部只剩一個名義上的朝廷：阿維圖斯、馬里安、利比烏斯·塞維魯、阿姆尼烏斯一個接一個被推上前台，其中多數由蠻族將領或東羅馬的將軍扶立，457年後意大利的實際防務開始交給同盟者軍隊與汪達爾人——455年守羅馬的正是基斯納里克的部隊，這是整個西羅馬歷史最刺眼的諷刺。第二，帝國的防務第一次明確外包給東部：468年君士坦丁堡才派來遠征軍，此前十三年的西羅馬只能靠談判、付費與臨時徵召。第三，海權的意義被重新定價：汪達爾用徵來的商船組成的運輸船隊一次投送整支部隊，技術上羅馬從未能追平；羅馬輸掉的不只是一座城，而是能攔截它的艦隊與港口控制，從410年「糧食決定戰爭」到455年「海運決定戰爭」，重心又移了一次。第四，外交制度改變：良一與基斯納里克的會面樹立了主教出使的先例，羅馬城從此與教會的存亡綁在一起。最後是象徵：455年羅馬第一次被一個北非王國奪城，也是帝國第一次承認自己無力保衛自己的首都，距離476年只剩下二十一年。
impactEn: After 455 the authority of the Western Empire was never restored. The West kept only a nominal court: Avitus, Majorian, Libius Severus and Anthemius were pushed forward one after another, most of them raised by barbarian generals or by generals of the Eastern Empire, and after 457 the actual defence of Italy began to be handed to federate war-bands and to Vandals, the troops that held Rome in 455 being Genseric's own, which is the sharpest irony in the whole history of the Western Empire. Second, the defence of the west was explicitly outsourced to the East: Constantinople sent an expedition only in 468, and for the thirteen years before that the West could do nothing but negotiate, pay and improvise levies. Third, the meaning of sea power was repriced: a transport fleet built out of requisitioned merchant ships delivered an entire army in a single move, and Rome never matched that technically; what Rome lost was not merely a city but the fleet and the harbour control needed to intercept it, so that the deciding factor moved once more, from the grain that decided war in 410 to the sea carriage that decided it in 455. Fourth, the machinery of diplomacy changed: the meeting between Leo and Genseric set a precedent for bishops serving as envoys, and the city of Rome was from that point bound up with the survival of the church. Finally there is the symbolic weight: in 455 Rome was taken for the first time by a kingdom from North Africa, and the empire admitted for the first time that it could not protect its own capital, with only twenty-one years left before 476.
result: 就戰役本身：6月15日入城，掠奪約兩日，奧勒良城牆與大教堂大體存留，但軍械庫、府庫、銅像與金銀器被搬上船，艦隊在夏季結束前帶著戰利品退回北非，沿途掃過西西里、薩丁尼亞、科西嘉與巴利阿里群島的港口。就政治：455年5月被殺的馬西姆沒有留下能用的軍力，阿維圖斯9月即位時意大利已在汪達爾的刀下走過一趟，456年他在科西嘉外海被擊敗，10月在拉文納被殺，12月馬里安即位。就戰略：455年之後羅馬在義大利唯一的任務是重建海軍，457年馬里安造出艦隊並襲擊汪達爾在薩丁尼亞與西西里的據點，460年這支艦隊在阿格里真托附近被毀，汪達爾反過來掃掠意大利海岸直到熱那亞與斯普利多海峽，最終在468年取得西西里。羅馬沒有滅亡，但此後只能靠借兵與付費自保；帝國的重心留在君士坦丁堡，意大利的實際統治權逐步落到里基梅、阿斯帕爾與奧多亞塞這些蠻族將領手上，476年最後一位西部皇帝被廢時，羅馬城已經十五年沒有皇帝住過。
resultEn: As a campaign: the city was entered on 15 June, plundered for about two days; the Aurelian wall and the great basilicas largely survived, but the arsenals, the treasury, the bronze statuary and the plate were carried onto the ships, and the fleet carried its loot back to Africa before the end of the summer, sweeping the harbours of Sicily, Sardinia, Corsica and the Balearics on the way. As politics: Maximus, killed in May 455, left behind no usable military force, and by the time Avitus was crowned in September Italy had already been marched through once by the Vandals; in 456 he was beaten off Corsica and killed at Ravenna in October, and Majorian came to the throne in December. As strategy: after 455 the only task left to Rome in Italy was to rebuild a navy; Majorian built one in 457 and struck at the Vandal bases in Sardinia and Sicily, and in 460 that fleet was destroyed off Agrigento, after which Genseric swept the Italian coast as far as Genoa and the Strait of Messina and finally took Sicily in 468. Rome did not cease to exist, but from then on it could only buy its safety with borrowed troops and money; the centre of the empire stayed at Constantinople, and effective rule over Italy passed gradually to barbarian generals such as Ricimer, Aspar and Odoacer, so that when the last Western emperor was deposed in 476 the city of Rome had not seen an emperor resident for fifteen years.
